title: Letter and Bridge
author: Dominic Dravenmoor
blurb: Gideon Vane, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, has spent twenty years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
